fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-10-10 at roughly 16:40, it was reported that the proprietor of Ezhil Cycle Mart noticed missing stock (hardware goods) valued at Rs. 40,000 near Vaigai Layout Market Road. Contact details given by the complainant, Yuvaraj Anand, include the number 9000000102. The complainant is associated with the business Ezhil Cycle Mart. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Chithra Kannan, using the number 9000000146. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00189, as the mobile number 9000000146 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Missing stock noticed at closing time and a review of shop CCTV was requested.
fields.Keywords: shop theft, stock, suspect, market road, afternoon, mobile number
